detail_observations.label: Objectives
detail_observations.text:
Talk to the two people in Veskal's Exchange to see what they have heard about Reingraf Morson, then follow the road Strey Willems sets.
- Speak to Achryn Cerurn in Veskal's Exchange
- Speak to Strey Willems in Veskal's Exchange

detail_observations.label: Description
detail_observations.text: "I just received word from another contact," Grom says, "that Reingraf was seen leaving Halgarad. Once you brought back his name, I sent someone to look after him. They, however, only followed him to Derogar's Post." "I have a feeling he's heading to Veskal's Exchange, as it's the next biggest outpost. Follow him out there and see what you can find out. I'll mark your map with two people I know who hear things."

findings.observation: Heading displays Level 4, Diplomacy, Halgarad and Thestra with The Stone Mug Tavern text. A recorded loc disagreement is attributed to fandom without a displayed alternative value. Details gives 10632, 52180, 52002; neither heading nor Details establishes the conversation targets spawn positions.

Primary objectives name Achryn Cerurn and Strey Willems in Veskals Exchange and say follow the road Strey Willems sets. The attributed fandom account spells the final surname Wilems. Preserve the variant rather than resolving identities by name.

Notes assigns the same printed coordinates -34410, -10850, 51682 to Achryn in the Tavern and Strey in the Crafting area (Plots Informant). These distinct textual contexts and the repeated coordinates are retained without correcting either.

Achryn notes explicitly show Presence: 15 Domestic. Strey notes show an empty Presence label. Both notes include Exchanging Information :4; its precise meaning is not resolved. Do not carry Achryns value to Strey or infer complete encounter parameters.

Two unrendered galleries retain eight filenames including Outsiders outlook, Good point, Greener pastures, Shrewd joke, Brief diatribe, Merchant musings, Gut feeling and Moral authority. Full spellings and markup are in the article evidence. These do not establish canonical card IDs, rewards or a complete encounter deck.

Details names Grom Vermach as starter and Lars Orson as hand-in, while objectives only identify Achryn and Strey as speaking targets. These roles remain separate observations; no completion script or conversation outcome is inferred.

Primary description and Silky Venom taking-dialogue differ in transcription (received/recieved and heading to/heading for). Original linked sources were not fetched; mirrored attributions are not independent corroboration.

Details displays Series Thestran Web Quests, Chain Thestra Web Quests, Previous Investigative Measures and Next Sweeper Agent. Navigation is not evidence of enforced prerequisites. Repeatable yes and unitless Coin reward 50 remain observations with unknown eligibility and denomination.
